title: Good shelves, but don't do black
text: Good shelves, but don't do black. I love this cart and it is what I needed.  However, I ordered the black instead of chrome.  As I am taking it out of the box, the black is chipping off and flaking all over the place.  It is  easy to put together, sturdy and does what I needed.  Just wish I had not ordered the black.  I would have sent it back and exchanged it but.....I would have had to take it apart and somehow get it back in the box.  Something that as a woman, 66 years old, I did not feel I could undertake.  I have kept it but if it continues to flake and the paint come off, I will have to move it out of my kitchen and just use it in a work area.  That is bad because, I need it in my kitchen.  Any suggestions as to how to s top the chipping paint?
